_meta.coordinates: zero-based [x,y], relative to the sprite rectangle
_meta.mouth_format: [x,y,width]; null if there is no mouth
_meta.light: upper left, Lambert + 0.25 ambient, broad warty relief
_meta.compositing: Stamp the full padded rectangle, including spaces. Do not trim rows.
_meta.faces: Full faces are baked in. To replace one, blank each face_clear span, then stamp eyes and mouth. Match posture before choosing coordinates.
_meta.spore: One seed dot under a cracked sand crust. eyes=[] and mouth=null are deliberate. Do not give it an adult face.
_meta.no_face: mound and stones have eyes=[] and mouth=null; mound_peek has only eyes.
_meta.wilting: Ink density is reduced to 65 percent. Use one ink color, not gray glyph colors.
_meta.ground: Place the last row at world row 24. Center the full sprite width in the 40-column world.
_meta.alternatives: Top-level assets are classic. styles contains complete alternative dictionaries.
